√katth 'boast'
present: [1.] katthate etc. E.+ katthati etc. 
[perfect: cakatthe akatthiṣṭa katthiṣyate katthitā ]
verbal: katthita E.+ katthitum 
secondary: causative: katthayati 
derivatives: -katthā katthaka C. -katthin E.+ katthana E.+ katthitavya C. 
A secondary prakritized root, but of unclear derivation.
